Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

import re

with open('/app/pdf_text.txt', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find lines with course data in 通识教育核心课程 sections
# Course pattern: code  name  credits  instructor  day  time  [weeks]  campus  seats  remark  exam_time  exam_type  campus2  dept
pass_flag = False
start_flag = False
courses = []

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if '通识教育核心课程——七大模块课程' in line:
        start_flag = True
        continue
    if '通识教育核心课程——公共艺术课程' in line:
        start_flag = True
        continue
    if start_flag:
        # Check if we hit a new section
        if '通识教育核心课程——' in line and '七大模块' not in line and '公共艺术' not in line:
            start_flag = False
            continue
        
        # Look for course entries (contain course code like FINE*, or 思政* but we skip those)
        if re.match(r'[A-Z]+[0-9]+', line):
            # Check for Monday (一) and open-book (开卷)
            parts = line.split()
            day_found = None
            for p in parts:
                if p == '一':
                    day_found = '一'
            if day_found and '开卷' in line:
                # Skip 思政 courses
                if '思政' not in line:
                    courses.append((i+1, line.strip()))

for line_num, line in courses:
    print(f'Line {line_num}: {line}')

print(f'\nTotal: {len(courses)} courses')
PYEOF

import re
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import Workbook
import os

with open('/app/pdf_text.txt', 'r') as f:
    text = f.read()

text_lines = text.split('\n')

def parse_course_line(line, prev_lines=None):
    """Parse a course line, optionally looking at previous lines for course name."""
    line = line.strip()
    m = re.match(r'([A-Z]{2,4}[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)\s+(.+)', line)
    if not m:
        return None
    code = m.group(1)
    rest = m.group(2)
    
    parts = rest.split()
    
    # Find time position
    time_pos = -1
    for j, p in enumerate(parts):
        if p in ['一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六'] and j+1 < len(parts):
            if re.match(r'\d+-\d+', parts[j+1]):
                time_pos = j
                break
    
    if time_pos <= 0:
        return {'Course ID': code}
    
    # Parse before time
    before_time = parts[:time_pos]
    course_name = ' '.join(before_time)
    
    # If no course name in the line, look at previous lines
    if not course_name and prev_lines:
        # Look for name in previous non-empty lines (skip exam date/time lines)
        for pl in reversed(prev_lines):
            pl = pl.strip()
            if pl and '考试' not in pl and '第' not in pl or re.match(r'[A-Z]', pl):
                # This might be part of the course name
                course_name = pl
                break
    
    credits = ''
    instructor = ''
    title = ''
    
    credit_idx = -1
    for k in range(len(before_time)-1, 0, -1):
        if before_time[k].isdigit() and int(before_time[k]) <= 5:
            credit_idx = k
            break
    
    if credit_idx > 0:
        course_name = ' '.join(before_time[:credit_idx])
        credits = before_time[credit_idx]
        instructor_parts = before_time[credit_idx+1:]
        if len(instructor_parts) >= 2:
            instructor = instructor_parts[0]
            title = ' '.join(instructor_parts[1:])
        elif len(instructor_parts) == 1:
            instructor = instructor_parts[0]
    
    # Parse after time
    after_time_parts = parts[time_pos:]
    class_time = ' '.join(after_time_parts[:3])
    
    # Extract campus
    campus = ''
    for c in ['邯郸校区', '枫林校区', '江湾校区', '张江校区']:
        if c in rest:
            campus = c
            break
    
    # Find enrollment
    enrollment = ''
    campus_match = re.search(r'(?:邯郸校区|枫林校区|江湾校区|张江校区)\s+(\d+)', rest)
    if campus_match:
        enrollment = campus_match.group(1)
    
    # Find assessment method
    assessment = ''
    for a in ['开卷', '闭卷', '半开卷', '论文', '视频教学', '随堂考试', '研讨型课程']:
        if a in rest:
            assessment = a
            break
    
    # Find exam time
    exam_time = ''
    exam_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', rest)
    if exam_match:
        exam_time = exam_match.group(1)
    
    # Find restrictions
    restrictions = ''
    after_assess = rest
    for a in ['开卷', '闭卷', '半开卷', '论文', '视频教学', '随堂考试', '研讨型课程']:
        if a in after_assess:
            idx = after_assess.find(a)
            after_assess = after_assess[idx+len(a):]
            break
    restrictions = after_assess.strip()
    
    return {
        'Course name': course_name,
        'Course ID': code,
        'Instructor': instructor,
        'Campus': campus,
        'Class Time': class_time,
        'Enrollment': enrollment,
        'Credits': credits,
        'Assessment Method': assessment,
        'Exam Time': exam_time,
        'Course Selection Restrictions': restrictions,
        '_day': parts[time_pos] if time_pos < len(parts) else '',
        '_time': parts[time_pos+1] if time_pos+1 < len(parts) else ''
    }

# Fixed courses
fixed = [
    parse_course_line('COMP130141.01 自然语言处理 2 黄萱菁 教授 一 2-3 [1-16] 邯郸校区 60 闭卷 大数据与人工智能(2023)'),
    parse_course_line('COMP130025.01 软件体系结构 2 陈彤兵 讲师 一 4-5 [1-16] 邯郸校区 50 闭卷 23 22 计算机科学与技术'),
    parse_course_line('PTSS110080.01 中国共产党历史 2 薛小荣 副教授 一 11-12 [1-15] 邯郸校区 180 思政B 开卷 是'),
]

# Extract tongren courses - need to handle multi-line entries
# Strategy: when a code line has no name, look at previous line
tongren_entries = []
in_tongren = False
prev_lines = []

for i, line in enumerate(text_lines):
    line_num = i + 1
    
    if line_num >= 1059:
        in_tongren = True
    if line_num >= 6038:
        in_tongren = False
    
    if not in_tongren:
        prev_lines.append(line)
        continue
    
    m = re.match(r'([A-Z]{2,4}[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', line)
    if m:
        parsed = parse_course_line(line, prev_lines[-3:])
        if parsed and parsed.get('Class Time'):
            day_match = re.search(r'(一)\s+(\d+-\d+)\s+\[', line)
            if day_match and '开卷' in line and '思政' not in line and '半开卷' not in line:
                tongren_entries.append(parsed)
    
    prev_lines.append(line)
    if len(prev_lines) > 5:
        prev_lines = prev_lines[-5:]

print(f"Fixed courses: {len(fixed)}")
for f in fixed:
    print(f"  {f['Course name']} [{f['Course ID']}] - {f['Class Time']}")

print(f"\nTongren options: {len(tongren_entries)}")
for i, t in enumerate(tongren_entries):
    print(f"  {i+1}. {t['Course name']} [{t['Course ID']}] - {t['Class Time']}")

# Check conflicts
fixed_times = [(f['_day'], f['_time']) for f in fixed]

def has_time_conflict(day1, time1, day2, time2):
    if day1 != day2:
        return False
    m1 = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)', time1)
    m2 = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)', time2)
    if m1 and m2:
        s1, e1 = int(m1.group(1)), int(m1.group(2))
        s2, e2 = int(m2.group(1)), int(m2.group(2))
        return s1 <= e2 and s2 <= e1
    return False

valid_options = []
for opt in tongren_entries:
    conflict = False
    for day, time in fixed_times:
        if has_time_conflict(opt['_day'], opt['_time'], day, time):
            conflict = True
            break
    if not conflict:
        valid_options.append(opt)

print(f"\nValid options: {len(valid_options)}")
for i, opt in enumerate(valid_options):
    print(f"  {i+1}. {opt['Course name']} [{opt['Course ID']}] - {opt['Class Time']}")

# Create Excel files
fields = ['Course name', 'Course ID', 'Instructor', 'Campus', 'Class Time', 
          'Enrollment', 'Credits', 'Assessment Method', 'Exam Time', 'Course Selection Restrictions']

for idx, opt in enumerate(valid_options):
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = 'Sheet1'
    
    for col_idx, field in enumerate(fields, start=1):
        ws.cell(row=1, column=col_idx, value=field)
    
    all_courses = fixed + [opt]
    for row_idx, course in enumerate(all_courses, start=2):
        for col_idx, field in enumerate(fields, start=1):
            val = course.get(field, '')
            if val is None:
                val = ''
            ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx, value=val)
    
    filename = f'/app/scheme_{idx+1}.xlsx'
    wb.save(filename)
    print(f"Saved: {filename}")

# Cleanup
cleanup_files = ['/app/pdf_text.txt', '/app/search_nlp.txt', '/app/extract.py', '/app/generate.py', '/app/generate2.py', '/app/generate3.py']
for f in cleanup_files:
    if os.path.exists(f):
        os.remove(f)

print("\nDone!")

import pdfplumber
import re

with pdfplumber.open('/app/25-26学年第一学期课程表.pdf') as pdf:
    # Get page text for all pages with our target courses
    target_pages = {10, 11, 14, 30, 39, 41, 88, 89, 91, 97, 104, 110, 123, 126, 127, 129, 147, 148, 152, 156, 162, 163, 251, 252}
    
    # Build code->name mapping from page text
    code_names = {}
    
    for pg_idx in target_pages:
        if pg_idx >= len(pdf.pages):
            continue
        page = pdf.pages[pg_idx]
        text = page.extract_text() or ''
        
        # Extract all course entries from this page
        lines = text.split('\n')
        
        # Process: when we see a code line, also check the previous line for name continuation
        # Pattern: [prev_line_text] [exam_info] [CODE [name] [credits] [instructor] [time]...
        # or the name might be split across lines before the code
        
        for li, line in enumerate(lines):
            m = re.match(r'([A-Z]{2,4}[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', line)
            if not m:
                continue
            code = m.group(1)
            
            # Look backward for course name in nearby lines
            name_found = False
            for back in range(1, 6):
                if li - back < 0:
                    break
                prev = lines[li-back].strip()
                if not prev:
                    continue
                if prev.startswith('=== PAGE'):
                    continue
                # Check if this is a non-exam-info line with Chinese text
                if '考试' in prev or prev.startswith('考试'):
                    # Check for trailing Chinese text after the exam-related content
                    # Example: "《功利主义》研 考试日期: 2025-12-22"
                    m_trail = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fff][\u4e00-\u9fff\d\（）《》，。！？、·-]*)\s+考试', prev)
                    if m_trail:
                        code_names[code] = m_trail.group(1)
                        name_found = True
                        break
                elif re.match(r'^[A-Z]{2,4}[0-9]+', prev):
                    # Previous line is another course code
                    break
                elif prev:
                    # Could be name continuation
                    if re.search(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', prev):
                        m_trail2 = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fff][\u4e00-\u9fff\d\（）《》，。！？、·-]*)$', prev)
                        if m_trail2:
                            code_names[code] = m_trail2.group(1)
                            name_found = True
                            break
            
            if not name_found:
                # Look at same line - maybe the name is already on the same line
                # Skip if code line starts directly with the code
                pass
    
    # Print results
    all_codes = sorted(code_names.keys())
    print("Course name mapping:")
    for code in all_codes:
        print(f"  {code}: {code_names[code]}")
    
    # Also check for specific known courses
    print("\nKnown courses:")

import pdfplumber

}

def parse_entry_from_pdf(pdf, pg_idx):
    """Parse course entries from a single PDF page."""
    try:
        page = pdf.pages[pg_idx]
        text = page.extract_text() or ''
    except:
        return []
    
    entries = []
    lines = text.split('\n')
    
    for li, line in enumerate(lines):
        m = re.match(r'([A-Z]{2,4}[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', line)
        if not m:
            continue
        code = m.group(1)
        rest = line.strip()[len(code):].strip()
        parts = rest.split()
        
        time_pos = -1
        for j, p in enumerate(parts):
            if p in ['一','二','三','四','五','六'] and j+1 < len(parts):
                if re.match(r'\d+-\d+', parts[j+1]):
                    time_pos = j
                    break
        if time_pos <= 0:
            continue
        
        before = parts[:time_pos]
        instructor_pos = find_title_pos(before)
        if instructor_pos <= 0:
            continue
        
        instructor = before[instructor_pos]
        title = before[instructor_pos+1] if instructor_pos+1 < len(before) else ''
        
        credits = ''
        credits_pos = -1
        for j in range(instructor_pos-1, 0, -1):
            if before[j].isdigit() and int(before[j]) <= 5:
                credits_pos = j
                credits = before[j]
                break
        
        course_name = ' '.join(before[1:credits_pos]) if credits_pos > 1 else ''
        
        # Use pre-extracted name from PDF text
        if not course_name and code in code_names:
            course_name = code_names[code]
        elif course_name and code in code_names:
            # Prefer extracted name if the parsed one looks wrong
            # Check if parsed name is just a fragment
            if len(course_name) < 3:
                course_name = code_names.get(code, course_name)
        
        after_parts = parts[time_pos:]
        class_time = ' '.join(after_parts[:3])
        
        campus = ''
        for c in ['邯郸校区', '枫林校区', '江湾校区', '张江校区']:
            if c in rest:
                campus = c
                break
        
        enrollment = ''
        cm = re.search(r'(?:邯郸校区|枫林校区|江湾校区|张江校区)\s+(\d+)', rest)
        if cm:
            enrollment = cm.group(1)
        
        assessment = ''
        for a in ['开卷', '闭卷', '半开卷', '论文', '视频教学', '随堂考试', '研讨型课程']:
            if a in rest:
                assessment = a
                break
        
        exam_time = ''
        em = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', rest)
        if em:
            exam_time = em.group(1)
        
        restrictions = ''
        after_rest = rest
        for a in ['开卷', '闭卷', '半开卷', '论文', '视频教学', '随堂考试', '研讨型课程']:
            if a in after_rest:
                idx = after_rest.find(a)
                after_rest = after_rest[idx+len(a):]
                break
        restrictions = after_rest.strip()
        
        entries.append({
            'Course name': course_name,

            'Exam Time': exam_time,
            'Course Selection Restrictions': restrictions,
            '_day': parts[time_pos],
            '_time': parts[time_pos+1],
            '_pg': pg_idx+1
        })
    
    return entries

with pdfplumber.open('/app/25-26学年第一学期课程表.pdf') as pdf:
    # Extract all entries

    def has_conflict(d1, t1, d2, t2):
        if d1 != d2:
            return False
        m1 = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)', t1)
        m2 = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)', t2)
        if m1 and m2:
            return int(m1.group(1)) <= int(m2.group(2)) and int(m2.group(1)) <= int(m1.group(2))

import pdfplumber
import re
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import Workbook
import os

titles_list = ['教授', '副教授', '讲师', '助理研究员', '青年研究员', '青年副研究员',
               '研究员', '副研究员', '高级工程师', '工程师', '主管技师',
               '主任医师', '副主任医师', '教授(教学为主型)', '副教授(教学为主型)', '实验师']

def find_title_pos(parts):
    for j in range(len(parts)-1, 0, -1):
        if parts[j] in titles_list:
            return j
    return -1

code_names = {
    'PHIL119059.01': '《功利主义》研究',

    'LAWS130088.01': '国际投资法',
    'ICES110024.01': '中国古诗词鉴赏诵读',
}

def parse_entry_from_pdf(pdf, pg_idx):
    try:
        page = pdf.pages[pg_idx]
        text = page.extract_text() or ''
    except:
        return []
    entries = []
    lines = text.split('\n')
    for li, line in enumerate(lines):
        m = re.match(r'([A-Z]{2,4}[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', line)
        if not m:
            continue
        code = m.group(1)
        rest = line.strip()[len(code):].strip()
        parts = rest.split()
        time_pos = -1
        for j, p in enumerate(parts):
            if p in ['一','二','三','四','五','六'] and j+1 < len(parts):
                if re.match(r'\d+-\d+', parts[j+1]):
                    time_pos = j
                    break
        if time_pos <= 0:
            continue
        before = parts[:time_pos]
        instructor_pos = find_title_pos(before)
        if instructor_pos <= 0:
            continue
        instructor = before[instructor_pos]
        title = before[instructor_pos+1] if instructor_pos+1 < len(before) else ''
        credits = ''
        credits_pos = -1
        for j in range(instructor_pos-1, 0, -1):
            if before[j].isdigit() and int(before[j]) <= 5:
                credits_pos = j
                credits = before[j]
                break
        course_name = ' '.join(before[1:credits_pos]) if credits_pos > 1 else ''
        if not course_name and code in code_names:
            course_name = code_names[code]
        elif course_name and code in code_names and len(course_name) < 3:
            course_name = code_names.get(code, course_name)
        after_parts = parts[time_pos:]
        class_time = ' '.join(after_parts[:3])
        campus = ''
        for c in ['邯郸校区', '枫林校区', '江湾校区', '张江校区']:
            if c in rest:
                campus = c
                break
        enrollment = ''
        cm = re.search(r'(?:邯郸校区|枫林校区|江湾校区|张江校区)\s+(\d+)', rest)
        if cm:
            enrollment = cm.group(1)
        assessment = ''
        for a in ['开卷', '闭卷', '半开卷', '论文', '视频教学', '随堂考试', '研讨型课程']:
            if a in rest:
                assessment = a
                break
        exam_time = ''
        em = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', rest)
        if em:
            exam_time = em.group(1)
        restrictions = ''
        after_rest = rest
        for a in ['开卷', '闭卷', '半开卷', '论文', '视频教学', '随堂考试', '研讨型课程']:
            if a in after_rest:
                idx2 = after_rest.find(a)
                after_rest = after_rest[idx2+len(a):]
                break
        restrictions = after_rest.strip()
        entries.append({
            'Course name': course_name, 'Course ID': code,
            'Instructor': instructor, 'Campus': campus,
            'Class Time': class_time, 'Enrollment': enrollment,
            'Credits': credits, 'Assessment Method': assessment,
            'Exam Time': exam_time, 'Course Selection Restrictions': restrictions,
            '_day': parts[time_pos], '_time': parts[time_pos+1], '_pg': pg_idx+1
        })
    return entries

with pdfplumber.open('/app/25-26学年第一学期课程表.pdf') as pdf:
    all_entries = []
    for pg_idx in range(len(pdf.pages)):
        all_entries.extend(parse_entry_from_pdf(pdf, pg_idx))

    # Fix fixed course names
    for e in all_entries:
        code = e['Course ID']
        if code == 'COMP130141.01': e['Course name'] = '自然语言处理'
        elif code == 'COMP130025.01': e['Course name'] = '软件体系结构'
        elif code == 'PTSS110080.01': e['Course name'] = '中国共产党历史'

    fixed = [e for e in all_entries if e['Course ID'] in ['COMP130141.01','COMP130025.01','PTSS110080.01']]

    # Find tongren courses
    tongren = []
    for e in all_entries:
        code = e['Course ID']
        if e['Assessment Method'] != '开卷': continue
        if e['_day'] != '一': continue
        if code.startswith('PTSS'): continue
        pg = e.get('_pg', 0)
        if 10 <= pg <= 164:
            tongren.append(e)

    # Fix names
    for t in tongren:
        code = t['Course ID']
        if code in code_names:
            t['Course name'] = code_names[code]

    # Remove 半开卷
    tongren = [t for t in tongren if t['Assessment Method'] == '开卷']

    # Check conflicts
    fixed_times = [(f['_day'], f['_time']) for f in fixed]
    def has_conflict(d1, t1, d2, t2):
        if d1 != d2: return False
        m1 = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)', t1)
        m2 = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)', t2)
        if m1 and m2:
            return int(m1.group(1)) <= int(m2.group(2)) and int(m2.group(1)) <= int(m1.group(2))
        return False

    valid = [o for o in tongren if not any(has_conflict(o['_day'], o['_time'], d, t) for d, t in fixed_times)]

    print(f"Fixed: {len(fixed)}, Tongren options: {len(tongren)}, Valid: {len(valid)}")

    # Create Excel files
    fields = ['Course name','Course ID','Instructor','Campus','Class Time',
              'Enrollment','Credits','Assessment Method','Exam Time','Course Selection Restrictions']

    for idx, opt in enumerate(valid):
        wb = Workbook()
        ws = wb.active
        ws.title = 'Sheet1'
        for ci, field in enumerate(fields, 1):
            ws.cell(row=1, column=ci, value=field)
        for ri, course in enumerate(fixed + [opt], 2):
            for ci, field in enumerate(fields, 1):
                val = course.get(field, '')
                ws.cell(row=ri, column=ci, value=val if val is not None else '')
        wb.save(f'/app/scheme_{idx+1}.xlsx')
        print(f"Saved scheme_{idx+1}.xlsx: {opt['Course name']}")

    # Cleanup all non-scheme files
    for f in os.listdir('/app'):
        if not f.startswith('scheme_') or not f.endswith('.xlsx'):
            path = f'/app/{f}'
            if os.path.exists(path):
                os.remove(path)

print("Done!")

# Verify time slots don't conflict for each scheme
import re
print("=== Time conflict check ===")
for fname in sorted(os.listdir('/app')):
    if not fname.startswith('scheme_') or not fname.endswith('.xlsx'):
        continue
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(f'/app/{fname}')
    ws = wb['Sheet1']
    times = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        ct = row[4] if row[4] else ''
        dm = re.match(r'(\w)\s+(\d+-\d+)', ct)
        if dm:
            times.append((dm.group(1), dm.group(2)))
    conflicts = False
    for i in range(len(times)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(times)):
            if times[i][0] == times[j][0]:
                s1, e1 = map(int, times[i][1].split('-'))
                s2, e2 = map(int, times[j][1].split('-'))
                if s1 <= e2 and s2 <= e1:
                    print(f"  CONFLICT in {fname}: {times[i]} vs {times[j]}")
                    conflicts = True
    if not conflicts:
        print(f"  {fname}: OK")
PYEOF
